title: Using a lecture audio receiver
titleZh: 講座輔聽接收器的使用方式
passage: If you would like an audio receiver for tonight’s lecture, please collect one at the entrance table. Staff will ask for your seat number so they can bring a spare if yours stops working. Test the receiver before entering the hall. You will hear a recorded message at the table. Once you sit down, the lecture channel will remain quiet until the host starts. If you do not hear the test message, return to the table before taking your seat. At the end, put working receivers in the blue tray and report any problem to the volunteer beside it.
passageZh: 如果今晚聽講座時想借用輔聽接收器，請到入口桌領取。工作人員會問你的座位號碼，好在接收器故障時送備用機過去。進會場前請先測試接收器，在入口桌會聽到一段錄好的訊息。就座後，在主持人開始前，講座頻道會保持安靜。若你沒有聽到測試訊息，請在就座前回入口桌。活動結束後，把正常運作的接收器放進藍色托盤；有任何問題請告訴托盤旁的志工。
